title: BooleanValuePresentation
description: How a boolean page column is rendered. Prefer lower-case values in descriptor JSON; PascalCase aliases are accepted for compatibility.
markdownDescription: `text` renders the configured display names (or Yes/No). `checkbox` renders a read-only check mark. `badge` renders a colored badge. `iconOnly` renders only the configured icon. Per-value labels, colors, and icons come from the column `booleanValues` object.
enumDescriptions: Icon only, display name as tooltip.
Icon only, display name as tooltip.
